entries.en: The club meets on alternate Fridays during term.
entries.zh: 学期中，俱乐部每隔一个星期五聚会一次。

entries.en: The story follows a child who refuses to bully others.
entries.zh: 这个故事讲述了一个拒绝欺负别人的孩子。

entries.en: The documentary shows how discarded plastic contaminates remote beaches.
entries.zh: 这部纪录片展示了废弃塑料如何污染偏远海滩。

entries.en: The museum has a gallery devoted to the country's unification.
entries.zh: 博物馆有一个专门介绍该国统一的展厅。

entries.en: Merry laughter drifted from the crowded dining room.
entries.zh: 拥挤的餐厅里传出欢乐的笑声。

entries.en: Her sober assessment helped us revise our unrealistic plan.
entries.zh: 她冷静的评估帮助我们修改了不切实际的计划。

entries.en: A frantic search finally uncovered the missing concert tickets.
entries.zh: 一番焦急的寻找后，丢失的音乐会门票终于找到了。

entries.en: The film follows villagers trying not to starve during a harsh winter.
entries.zh: 电影讲述了村民们在严冬中努力避免挨饿的经历。

entries.en: The fertile valley produces vegetables for the nearby towns.
entries.zh: 肥沃的山谷为附近城镇出产蔬菜。

entries.en: She looked at the mouldy sandwich with disgust.
entries.zh: 她厌恶地看着那块发霉的三明治。

entries.en: A huge ocean liner appeared beyond the harbour wall.
entries.zh: 一艘巨大的远洋客轮出现在港口堤岸外。

entries.en: The stack of empty boxes toppled onto the floor.
entries.zh: 那摞空箱子倒在了地板上。

entries.en: The old sewing machine had been idle for years.
entries.zh: 那台旧缝纫机已经闲置多年。

entries.en: We attended a preview of the exhibition before it opened.
entries.zh: 展览正式开放前，我们参加了预展。

entries.en: The class held a mock interview to practise answering questions.
entries.zh: 班里进行了一次模拟面试，练习回答问题。

entries.en: A small disagreement escalated into a noisy argument.
entries.zh: 一场小分歧升级成了吵闹的争执。

entries.en: We scrubbed the muddy boots before bringing them indoors.
entries.zh: 把沾泥的靴子拿进屋前，我们先刷洗了一遍。

entries.en: The stubborn drawer would not open despite our efforts.
entries.zh: 尽管我们费了不少劲，那个难拉的抽屉还是打不开。

entries.en: They bathed the muddy puppy in an old plastic tub.
entries.zh: 他们在一个旧塑料盆里给满身泥的小狗洗澡。

entries.en: We made a tentative booking for the last weekend in May.
entries.zh: 我们暂时预订了五月的最后一个周末。

entries.en: A quick change of venue averted the cancellation of the concert.
entries.zh: 及时更换场地，避免了音乐会被取消。

entries.en: The word but is a conjunction in this sentence.
entries.zh: 在这个句子里，but 是连词。

entries.en: Continual interruptions made it difficult to finish the recording.
entries.zh: 频繁的打断让录音很难完成。

entries.en: We needed time to digest the complicated instructions.
entries.zh: 我们需要时间来理解那些复杂的说明。

entries.en: The play's ruthless ruler dismisses everyone who questions him.
entries.zh: 剧中冷酷的统治者赶走所有质疑他的人。

entries.en: His arrogant reply annoyed even his closest friends.
entries.zh: 他傲慢的回答连最亲近的朋友都惹恼了。

entries.en: The new bypass keeps heavy traffic out of the village.
entries.zh: 新建的绕城道路使繁忙车流不再穿过村庄。

entries.en: The playwright stayed after the performance to answer questions.
entries.zh: 演出后，剧作家留下来回答问题。

entries.en: The apple had a dark bruise on one side.
entries.zh: 苹果的一侧有一块深色的碰伤。

entries.en: A savage storm battered the coast throughout the night.
entries.zh: 一场猛烈的风暴整夜袭击着海岸。

entries.en: The novel follows a bankrupt merchant rebuilding his life.
entries.zh: 小说讲述一位破产商人重新开始生活的故事。

entries.en: The museum dims its lights to conserve energy after closing.
entries.zh: 闭馆后，博物馆调暗灯光以节约能源。

entries.en: The first chapter introduces the basic vocabulary of genetics.
entries.zh: 第一章介绍了遗传学的基本术语。

entries.en: She diluted the blue paint to create a pale sky.
entries.zh: 她把蓝色颜料调稀，画出淡色的天空。

entries.en: The old theatre was on the brink of closure.
entries.zh: 那家老剧院已濒临关门。

entries.en: The endless delays turned our journey into an ordeal.
entries.zh: 一次次延误让旅程成了一场折磨。

entries.en: Our eccentric neighbour keeps a model railway in his kitchen.
entries.zh: 我们那位古怪的邻居在厨房里摆着模型铁路。

entries.en: We roasted vegetables while the bread cooled on the rack.
entries.zh: 面包在架上晾凉时，我们烤了蔬菜。

entries.en: She gave me a discreet signal that it was time to leave.
entries.zh: 她悄悄向我示意，该离开了。

entries.en: The tiny museum owns a masterpiece by a local painter.
entries.zh: 这家小博物馆收藏着一位本地画家的杰作。

entries.en: He recalled the humiliation of forgetting every line onstage.
entries.zh: 他回想起在台上忘掉所有台词的窘迫。

entries.en: My little brother adores stories about talking animals.
entries.zh: 我弟弟特别喜欢会说话的动物的故事。

entries.en: My feet ached after a day of exploring the city.
entries.zh: 在城里逛了一天后，我的双脚很酸痛。

entries.en: To our dismay, the museum was closed for repairs.
entries.zh: 令我们沮丧的是，博物馆因维修而关闭。

entries.en: She added a pinch of cinnamon to the hot chocolate.
entries.zh: 她往热巧克力里加了一撮肉桂粉。

entries.en: Their quarrel ended when they discovered both maps were wrong.
entries.zh: 发现两张地图都错了之后，他们不再争吵。

entries.en: He changed into dry pants after walking through the rain.
entries.zh: 冒雨走来后，他换上了干裤子。

entries.en: A narrow road follows the coast around the peninsula.
entries.zh: 一条窄路沿海岸绕着半岛延伸。

entries.en: The menu lists alcoholic drinks on a separate page.
entries.zh: 菜单把含酒精饮品列在单独一页上。

entries.en: She relished the chance to perform with her old friends.
entries.zh: 她很享受与老朋友们一起表演的机会。

entries.en: Our inefficient filing system made every search take ages.
entries.zh: 我们低效的归档系统让每次查找都耗时很久。

entries.en: The constant clicking of his pen irritated everyone nearby.
entries.zh: 他不停按笔的声音让附近的人都很烦。

entries.en: The science display explains where uranium appears in the periodic table.
entries.zh: 科学展板解释了铀在元素周期表中的位置。

entries.en: The tailor adjusted the sleeves of my old jacket.
entries.zh: 裁缝修改了我旧夹克的袖子。

entries.en: A ceramic bowl held the colourful glass marbles.
entries.zh: 一个陶瓷碗里装着彩色玻璃弹珠。

entries.en: The committee will convene a meeting to choose the exhibition theme.
entries.zh: 委员会将召开会议，选择展览主题。

entries.meaningZh: 光彩照人的；富有魅力的
entries.en: The old photographs show the glamorous side of ocean travel.
entries.zh: 这些老照片展现了远洋旅行光鲜迷人的一面。

entries.en: She aspires to become a designer of children's playgrounds.
entries.zh: 她立志成为儿童游乐场设计师。

entries.en: The campfire flared when the wind changed direction.
entries.zh: 风向一变，营火突然旺了起来。

entries.en: Rain left the stone steps slick and shining.
entries.zh: 雨水使石阶湿滑发亮。

entries.en: She dyed the faded curtains a deep blue.
entries.zh: 她把褪色的窗帘染成了深蓝色。

entries.en: The concert ended with simultaneous bursts of light and sound.
entries.zh: 音乐会以同时迸发的声光效果结束。

entries.en: The locked door at the end of the corridor intrigued us.
entries.zh: 走廊尽头那扇锁着的门引起了我们的好奇。

entries.en: The incumbent club president welcomed the newly elected committee.
entries.zh: 现任俱乐部会长欢迎了新选出的委员会。

entries.en: The novel explores how an extremist gains influence in a small town.
entries.zh: 小说探讨了一名极端主义者如何在小镇获得影响力。

entries.en: A hawk circled slowly above the empty field.
entries.zh: 一只鹰在空旷的田野上方缓缓盘旋。

entries.en: A stone plaque commemorates the opening of the village school.
entries.zh: 一块石牌纪念了村校的落成。

entries.en: I bought a used paperback to read on the train.
entries.zh: 我买了一本二手平装书，准备在火车上读。

entries.en: Deduct the empty box's weight to find the weight of the apples.
entries.zh: 减去空箱子的重量，就能得到苹果的重量。

entries.en: The café chose durable cups for its busy outdoor tables.
entries.zh: 咖啡馆为使用频繁的露天座位选了耐用的杯子。

entries.en: The documentary compares rural life with life in industrialized cities.
entries.zh: 这部纪录片比较了乡村生活与工业化城市的生活。

entries.en: A red cock crowed from the top of the farm gate.
entries.zh: 一只红公鸡站在农场大门上啼叫。

entries.en: The community centre offers a martial arts class on Saturdays.
entries.zh: 社区中心每周六开设武术课。

entries.en: The sudden silence heightened the tension in the theatre.
entries.zh: 突然的寂静加剧了剧场里的紧张气氛。

entries.en: A shared love of music unified the diverse group.
entries.zh: 对音乐的共同热爱使这群背景各异的人团结起来。

entries.en: A tanker moved slowly past the harbour entrance.
entries.zh: 一艘油轮缓缓驶过港口入口。

entries.en: A string quartet played during the wedding reception.
entries.zh: 婚宴期间，一支弦乐四重奏组合进行了演奏。

entries.en: The staircase rises in a tight spiral inside the tower.
entries.zh: 楼梯在塔内呈紧密的螺旋形向上延伸。

entries.en: The two musicians wed in a small seaside chapel.
entries.zh: 这两位音乐家在海边的一座小教堂结婚了。

entries.en: The exhibition records wartime atrocities through survivors' accounts.
entries.zh: 这场展览通过幸存者的讲述记录战时暴行。

entries.en: The painting shows cavalry approaching a distant hill.
entries.zh: 这幅画描绘了骑兵向远处一座山丘进发的情景。

entries.en: Bees buzzed around the lavender beside the path.
entries.zh: 蜜蜂在小路旁的薰衣草周围嗡嗡飞舞。

entries.en: An old hound slept beside the farmer's chair.
entries.zh: 一只老猎犬睡在农夫的椅子旁。

entries.en: The members voted to ratify the club's revised constitution.
entries.zh: 会员们投票正式批准了修订后的俱乐部章程。

entries.en: The box contained an exquisite miniature carved from wood.
entries.zh: 盒子里装着一件精美的微型木雕。

entries.en: The exhibit traces the history of petroleum transport.
entries.zh: 这个展览追溯了石油运输的历史。

entries.en: In the film, the singer's bodyguard secretly writes poetry.
entries.zh: 电影里，歌手的保镖偷偷写诗。

entries.en: She paused to marshal her thoughts before answering.
entries.zh: 回答前，她停下来理了理思绪。

entries.en: The flags flapped loudly above the empty square.
entries.zh: 旗帜在空广场上方被吹得啪啪作响。

entries.en: His constant complaints began to alienate the other volunteers.
entries.zh: 他不停抱怨，开始让其他志愿者疏远他。

entries.en: The sting of her criticism faded after a few days.
entries.zh: 几天后，她的批评带来的刺痛消退了。

entries.en: The velvet curtains gave the tiny stage a touch of glamour.
entries.zh: 天鹅绒幕布给小舞台增添了几分迷人的光彩。

entries.en: The chair invited dissent before putting the proposal to a vote.
entries.zh: 主席在将提案付诸表决前，请大家提出不同意见。

entries.en: The history display explains the equipment carried by infantry.
entries.zh: 历史展板介绍了步兵携带的装备。

entries.en: The smaller clubs formed a bloc to support the new tournament.
entries.zh: 几家较小的俱乐部组成联盟，支持新的锦标赛。

entries.en: The fragrance of jasmine filled the warm evening air.
entries.zh: 温暖的晚风中弥漫着茉莉花香。

entries.en: She had a witty retort ready for his teasing remark.
entries.zh: 面对他的打趣，她已准备好机智的回话。

entries.en: The explorer hacked through the tangled vines in the adventure film.
entries.zh: 在冒险片中，探险者砍开了缠结的藤蔓。

entries.en: A metal clamp held the two pieces of wood together.
entries.zh: 一个金属夹具把两块木头夹在一起。

entries.en: The film crew assembled a camera rig beside the window.
entries.zh: 摄制组在窗边组装了一套摄影装置。

entries.meaningZh: 多愁善感的；富有感情色彩的
entries.en: I keep the broken watch for sentimental reasons.
entries.zh: 出于感情上的原因，我一直留着那只坏表。

entries.en: I misunderstood the invitation and arrived a day early.
entries.zh: 我误解了邀请函上的意思，早到了一天。

entries.en: Our relay team practised passing the baton after school.
entries.zh: 我们的接力队放学后练习交接棒。

entries.en: The war poem mourns the pointless slaughter of young soldiers.
entries.zh: 这首战争诗哀悼年轻士兵遭受的无谓杀戮。

entries.en: The heroine solves the mystery by studying an old map.
entries.zh: 女主角通过研究一张旧地图解开了谜团。

entries.en: The wind howled around the lonely mountain hut.
entries.zh: 风在孤零零的山间小屋周围呼啸。

entries.en: A yellow crane lifted beams above the building site.
entries.zh: 一台黄色起重机在工地上吊起横梁。

entries.en: The narrow doorway hampered our efforts to move the piano.
entries.zh: 狭窄的门口妨碍了我们搬钢琴。

entries.en: I began to lag behind the others on the steep climb.
entries.zh: 爬陡坡时，我开始落在其他人后面。

entries.en: Heavy rain lashed the windows throughout the afternoon.
entries.zh: 大雨整个下午都猛烈地拍打着窗户。

entries.en: A long scratch marred the surface of the new table.
entries.zh: 一道长划痕损坏了新桌子的表面。

entries.en: I envy her ability to draw a perfect circle freehand.
entries.zh: 我羡慕她能徒手画出一个完美的圆。

entries.en: He grated some cheese over the steaming pasta.
entries.zh: 他把一些奶酪擦碎，撒在热气腾腾的意面上。

entries.en: The students voted to boycott the badly organized competition.
entries.zh: 学生们投票决定抵制那场组织混乱的比赛。

entries.en: Our outdoor rehearsal is contingent on the weather.
entries.zh: 我们能否在户外排练取决于天气。

entries.en: She showed admirable patience with the nervous beginners.
entries.zh: 她对紧张的初学者表现出了令人钦佩的耐心。

entries.en: The choir diversified its repertoire by adding folk songs.
entries.zh: 合唱团加入民歌，使演唱曲目更加多样化。

entries.en: In the play, the villagers unite to overthrow the tyrant.
entries.zh: 剧中，村民们联合起来推翻暴君。

entries.en: The abrupt ending left the audience sitting in silence.
entries.zh: 突如其来的结尾让观众静静地坐着。

entries.en: She joined the school athletics team to practise the long jump.
entries.zh: 她加入了学校田径队，练习跳远。

entries.en: The crook in the comedy hides stolen jewels in a teapot.
entries.zh: 喜剧中的罪犯把偷来的珠宝藏在茶壶里。

entries.en: We sprinted towards the bus, but the doors had closed.
entries.zh: 我们朝公交车飞奔过去，可车门已经关了。

entries.en: The relief exhibition tells stories of families facing starvation.
entries.zh: 这场救援主题展览讲述了面临饥饿的家庭的故事。

entries.en: A solemn silence followed the reading of the poem.
entries.zh: 诗歌朗读后，现场陷入庄严的寂静。

entries.en: The course begins with an ancient epic about a long journey.
entries.zh: 这门课从一部讲述漫长旅程的古代史诗开始。

entries.en: The photographs seduced us into booking a seaside holiday.
entries.zh: 那些照片让我们心动，预订了一次海滨假期。

entries.en: The tiny details in her drawings never fail to amaze me.
entries.zh: 她画中细小的细节总让我惊叹。

entries.en: A red toy car zoomed across the kitchen floor.
entries.zh: 一辆红色玩具车飞快地驶过厨房地板。

entries.en: The actor wore a silver wig for the final scene.
entries.zh: 最后一场戏中，演员戴了一顶银色假发。

entries.en: We took a brisk walk before sitting down to breakfast.
entries.zh: 我们先轻快地走了一段路，然后坐下来吃早饭。

entries.en: The thriller kept me reading long after midnight.
entries.zh: 那本惊险小说让我过了午夜很久还在读。

entries.en: The town hopes to woo visitors with its new arts festival.
entries.zh: 小镇希望用新办的艺术节吸引游客。

entries.en: The soup looked colourful but tasted rather bland.
entries.zh: 那碗汤看着色彩丰富，吃起来却相当寡淡。

entries.en: In the story, the children smuggle a kitten into their dormitory.
entries.zh: 故事里，孩子们偷偷把一只小猫带进宿舍。

entries.en: The old kitchen scale measures ingredients in ounces.
entries.zh: 那台旧厨房秤用盎司计量食材。

entries.en: I could not visualize the room until she drew a plan.
entries.zh: 直到她画出平面图，我才想象得出房间的样子。

entries.en: Fresh mint grew in a pot outside the kitchen.
entries.zh: 厨房外的一个花盆里长着新鲜薄荷。

entries.en: Our jolly guide kept everyone laughing during the rainy tour.
entries.zh: 下雨的游览途中，开朗的导游逗得大家笑个不停。

entries.en: She shredded the old wrapping paper for the craft project.
entries.zh: 她把旧包装纸撕成细条，用来做手工。

entries.en: My instinctive reaction was to catch the falling cup.
entries.zh: 我本能的反应是接住掉落的杯子。

entries.en: The biography follows the statesman's life from childhood to retirement.
entries.zh: 这本传记讲述了那位政治家从童年到退休的一生。

entries.en: The committee was unanimous in choosing her design.
entries.zh: 委员会一致同意选择她的设计。

entries.meaningZh: 使人清爽的；令人振奋的
entries.en: A refreshing breeze blew through the hot classroom.
entries.zh: 一阵清爽的风吹过闷热的教室。

entries.en: I dread sorting the boxes in our crowded attic.
entries.zh: 我一想到要整理挤满东西的阁楼里的箱子就发愁。

entries.en: This versatile actor can move easily between comedy and tragedy.
entries.zh: 这位多才多艺的演员能自如地驾驭喜剧和悲剧。

entries.en: The smell of freshly baked bread was irresistible.
entries.zh: 刚出炉的面包香味令人无法抗拒。

entries.en: The spinning fairground ride left me dizzy.
entries.zh: 游乐场里旋转的游乐设施让我头晕。

entries.en: The ancient road once carried pilgrims towards the mountain shrine.
entries.zh: 朝圣者曾沿这条古道前往山中的神殿。

entries.en: The exhibition shows how smoke once polluted the city's air.
entries.zh: 展览展示了烟雾曾如何污染这座城市的空气。

entries.en: She doled out the last biscuits one at a time.
entries.zh: 她把最后几块饼干一块一块地分出去。

entries.en: A smear of green paint marked his sleeve.
entries.zh: 他的袖子上留着一抹绿色油漆。

entries.en: The novel opens with a failed attempt to assassinate the king.
entries.zh: 小说以一次暗杀国王的失败行动开篇。

entries.en: A narrow boardwalk led us across the bog.
entries.zh: 一条狭窄的木栈道带我们穿过沼泽。

entries.en: A bright trumpet solo rose above the rest of the band.
entries.zh: 一段嘹亮的小号独奏响起，盖过了乐队其他声部。

entries.en: He chose tan boots to match his old leather bag.
entries.zh: 他挑了棕褐色靴子来搭配旧皮包。

entries.meaningZh: 反复出现的；长期存在的
entries.en: The missing kettle is a perennial mystery in our shared kitchen.
entries.zh: 在我们的共用厨房里，水壶失踪是个反复出现的谜。

entries.en: Experienced swimmers were exempt from the introductory session.
entries.zh: 有经验的游泳者可以不参加入门课。

entries.en: She mused about the people who had lived in the old house.
entries.zh: 她出神地想着曾住在那座老屋里的人们。

entries.en: Tiny drops of water sparkled on the spider's web.
entries.zh: 细小的水珠在蜘蛛网上闪闪发亮。

entries.en: She wrote the lyrics while her brother composed the melody.
entries.zh: 她写歌词，她哥哥谱曲。

entries.en: We salvaged a few dry photographs from the soaked box.
entries.zh: 我们从湿透的箱子里抢救出几张干燥的照片。

entries.en: Quitting the project after one mistake would be rash.
entries.zh: 仅因一个错误就退出项目，会很轻率。

entries.en: The quarrelling neighbours declared a truce for the street party.
entries.zh: 为了一起办街区聚会，争吵的邻居暂时和解了。

entries.en: The original photograph discredited the story about a giant bird.
entries.zh: 原始照片证明那个关于巨鸟的故事不可信。

entries.en: A freak snowstorm closed the mountain road in midsummer.
entries.zh: 一场罕见的盛夏暴风雪封住了山路。

entries.en: The audience stood to salute the retiring conductor.
entries.zh: 观众起立，向即将退休的指挥致敬。

entries.en: Her quiet voice soothed the frightened child.
entries.zh: 她轻柔的声音安抚了受惊的孩子。

entries.en: A small tug towed the damaged boat into the harbour.
entries.zh: 一艘小拖船把受损的船拖进了港口。

entries.en: The modest invitation gave no hint of the lavish dinner ahead.
entries.zh: 朴素的邀请函完全看不出之后会有一顿丰盛晚宴。

entries.en: The café added two vegetarian dishes to its lunch menu.
entries.zh: 咖啡馆在午餐菜单上增加了两道素菜。

entries.en: Her final answer clinched victory for the school quiz team.
entries.zh: 她最后的回答为学校问答队锁定了胜利。

entries.en: The potter shaped a bowl while explaining each movement.
entries.zh: 陶艺家一边塑造碗，一边解释每个动作。

entries.en: The recipe measures the spices in grams.
entries.zh: 这份食谱以克计量香料。

entries.en: The trek to the lake took longer than we expected.
entries.zh: 前往湖边的长途徒步比我们预想的耗时更久。

entries.en: We tried to console her after her team lost the final.
entries.zh: 她的球队输掉决赛后，我们试着安慰她。

entries.en: The documentary compares the behaviour of wild and captive wolves.
entries.zh: 这部纪录片比较了野生狼与圈养狼的行为。

entries.en: She played an acoustic guitar beside the campfire.
entries.zh: 她在营火旁弹着一把原声吉他。

entries.en: A stray cat began sleeping beneath our porch.
entries.zh: 一只流浪猫开始睡在我们门廊下面。

entries.en: The umpire called the players back onto the tennis court.
entries.zh: 裁判叫球员们回到网球场上。

entries.en: The polished silver gleamed beneath the dining room lights.
entries.zh: 擦亮的银器在餐厅灯光下闪闪发亮。

entries.en: The sudden power failure crippled the city's tram network.
entries.zh: 突如其来的停电使全市有轨电车网络瘫痪。

entries.en: A tangle of cables lay behind the old television.
entries.zh: 旧电视后面堆着一团缠结的电缆。

entries.en: Her grandparents emigrated from a small village many years ago.
entries.zh: 她的祖父母很多年前从一个小村庄移居到了国外。

entries.en: The flowers looked limp after a day in the heat.
entries.zh: 花在炎热中放了一天，看起来蔫蔫的。

entries.en: Unlike the gods in the story, the hero is mortal.
entries.zh: 与故事中的神不同，主人公终究会死。

entries.en: The forgotten apples began to rot in the cellar.
entries.zh: 被遗忘的苹果开始在地窖里腐烂。

entries.en: A stern look from the teacher quietened the class.
entries.zh: 老师严厉地看了一眼，全班便安静下来。

entries.en: The child folded his arms in silent defiance.
entries.zh: 孩子抱起双臂，以沉默表示反抗。

entries.en: She gave a defiant smile and continued her difficult climb.
entries.zh: 她露出不服输的微笑，继续艰难攀登。

entries.en: The volunteers held their patient coordinator in high esteem.
entries.zh: 志愿者们十分敬重那位耐心的协调员。

entries.en: He brewed a fresh pot of tea for the visitors.
entries.zh: 他为来访者新沏了一壶茶。

entries.meaningZh: 持不同政见者；异议人士
entries.en: The biography tells the story of a writer who became a dissident.
entries.zh: 这本传记讲述了一位作家成为异议人士的故事。

entries.en: The cracked vase was relegated to a shelf in the shed.
entries.zh: 那只裂了的花瓶被放到了棚屋架子上，不再受重视。

entries.en: The young challenger ousted the champion in the opening round.
entries.zh: 年轻的挑战者在首轮就淘汰了冠军。

entries.en: We made a vain attempt to keep the sand out of our shoes.
entries.zh: 我们试图不让沙子进鞋里，却是徒劳。

entries.en: A small brass tack held the note to the wooden board.
entries.zh: 一枚小黄铜钉把便条钉在木板上。

entries.en: The students made posters to publicize their charity concert.
entries.zh: 学生们制作海报，宣传他们的慈善音乐会。

entries.en: The exhibition explores the vogue for bright colours in furniture.
entries.zh: 展览探讨了家具采用鲜艳色彩的流行风潮。

entries.en: The club publishes its illustrated newsletter quarterly.
entries.zh: 俱乐部每季度出版一次带插图的通讯。

entries.en: We found a videotape of our school's first concert.
entries.zh: 我们找到了一盘学校首场音乐会的录像带。
